title: Autonomy gate evidence artifact
description: Per ADR-037 D3. Emitted by a local-only gate (live golden, Docker integration, adversarial audit, wiring proof) that GitHub CI cannot run. Committed to the PR branch under evidence/<gate>.json. The ci-evidence job asserts freshness (head_sha == PR head) + verdict == PASS for every gate the phase declares in evidence/manifest.json, AND that every evidence-verified AC of the phase is named in some PASS artifact's ac_ids. Makes local gates un-fakeable at merge and doubles as founder's post-hoc audit trail. v2 (D-31/D-34, grill-2026-07-15): +ac_ids (binds proof to the claim, not just to the gate), +kind (wiring proof vs quality proof). v1 bound evidence to a GATE only — so a phase could be all-green while an AC asserting runtime behaviour was never actually exercised. That is exactly how AC-W1-4 reached main as dead code: unit-green, CI-green, nothing calling it. See .planning/WAVE-1-RETRO.md §A.

schema_version.description: Bump when the shape changes; verify_evidence.py pins this.

ac_ids.description: Which acceptance criteria THIS artifact discharges, by id, exactly as written in the phase spec's AC table. Covers every notation in canon: AC-02.6.3 (phase), AC-W1-4 (wave), AC-3.6 (01.2-era). verify_evidence.py cross-checks both ways: every id here must exist in the spec, and every evidence-verified AC in the spec must appear in some PASS artifact. A gate being green is not proof that a given claim was tested — this field is what makes it proof.

kind.description: wiring = the real path was exercised end-to-end (the feature is reachable and runs; ~$0.1, MANDATORY for any AC asserting runtime behaviour — a unit test cannot discharge it, dead code passes units trivially). quality = the behaviour is good enough (full golden dataset, adversarial audit; expensive, gated on control value per ADR-040 D11). Wave-1 evidence: both of the wave's costliest defects (AC-W1-4 dead relay, broken Dramatiq worker path) were caught ONLY by exercising the path — neither needed an expensive golden.

gate.description: Stable gate id, matches an entry in evidence/manifest.json required_gates (e.g. live_golden_memory, docker_integration, adversarial_audit).

head_sha.description: Full 40-char SHA of the commit the gate actually ran against. MUST equal the PR head SHA at CI time, else the evidence is stale and the gate fails.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the gate completed.

verdict.description: PASS is the only value that lets ci-evidence go green for this gate.

cost_usd.description: LLM/infra spend to produce this evidence (funded live goldens). Feeds the per-run budget audit.

runner.description: Who produced it — agent role / script name (e.g. scripts/live_golden_memory.py, reviewer-security).

details.description: Free-form gate-specific payload: golden pass counts, reviewer verdicts + refute-by-default confirmation, integration suite summary, etc.
